dish: sukiyaki of Japanese black beef in a light warishita (and the butcher-counter croquettes)
n: Sukiyaki Asari Honten, Hakodate (阿佐利 本店)
w: A 1901 beef shop turned sukiyaki specialist in an early-Shōwa building — black wagyu at fair prices, a limited weekday lunch, and croquettes from the ground-floor butcher.
